chronology.rule: This record is committed before the harness and before any timed TRAF-65 run.
chronology.prohibited_writeback: No TRAF-65 observation may change this file. A new hypothesis requires a new version and a new freeze.

tx.request_response_direction: write payload travels as request; read control travels as request and read payload travels as response

switch.note: Contention, FIFO placement, and head-of-line parameters belong to this module in non-pass-through profiles. They are inert and unidentifiable on the direct-mesh A100 profile.

rx.note: These are independent RX declarations, not copies of TX values.

global_acceptance.held_out_error: throughput and completion error no larger than 10 percent or 1 microsecond, whichever is larger
conservation: no loss, duplication, or double charge
required_records: per-link and per-direction raw and data counter deltas
global_acceptance.nccl_scope: NCCL send and receive validate protocol conservation only and never define packet format.

fatal_guards: rate above 25 GB/s per physical link
rate above 100 GB/s per ordered pair
rate above 300 GB/s per GPU direction

decision_rules.packet_overhead_vs_copy_engine_coalescin: Accept the 256+16 packet-overhead explanation only if raw-minus-data steps follow 16*ceil(payload/256) across SM writes, dependent reads, and copy-engine traffic, survive alignment, lane-mask, stride, reuse, and blind holdouts, and the common fitted form predicts completion. If the 94 GB/s envelope or steps occur only for the copy engine, or move with copy-engine message aggregation while SM counter steps do not, classify the effect as copy-engine coalescing and refute packet-format authority.
decision_rules.bonding: Four-link bonding requires four active per-link counter deltas, each no more than 25 GB/s, balance within the frozen band at saturation, ordered-pair payload inside the published 94.00 to 94.07 GB/s row, and three-way fan-out containing the published 281.65 GB/s row without exceeding 300 GB/s. Stream-count-only scaling or idle links refutes packet striping across four links.
decision_rules.credits: Finite credits require a reproducible first 95-percent knee across outstanding-window, burst, gap, and recovery sweeps, with the knee shifting by packet wire bytes and returning after the frozen recovery gap. A knee that follows only producer launch occupancy is not a credit result. Report fitted unit, window, and return latency as effective quantities.
decision_rules.fifo_placement: Source-local interference with other-peer bulk identifies TX queue scope; destination incast interference identifies RX ingress or merge scope. On A100 the switch module is pass-through, so any added bytes, time, reordering, or queue visit in that module is a fatal model defect rather than evidence of a physical switch FIFO.
decision_rules.head_of_line: Head-of-line blocking requires ordered small/large latency asymmetry that survives matched offered load and is localized by same-pair, other-peer, remote-incast, direction, and distinct-region controls. A shared-cache-line-only effect is memory acceptance, not transport FIFO evidence.
